WallsSieges Description: Changes apply after a full game restart. More options: Mymod_settings.txt
ws_camps Description: Armies set up camps with tents and siege guns near the besieged city.
ws_coast Description: Cities build small defence towers on the shore and stakes in the water.
ws_gates Description: Walls get gates that close when enemies approach.
ws_moat Description: Cities dig a moat outside the wall, with bridges at the gates.
ws_decay Description: Walls of shrinking or abandoned cities slowly crumble.
ws_news Description: Show world-log messages about walls and sieges.
ws_horn Description: Play a horn sound when an enemy camp appears.
ws_wall_share Description: Share of siege gun shots aimed at walls instead of gates (0 = gates only).
ws_gate_hp Description: Gate durability against siege guns. Default 900.
ws_reload Description: Siege gun reload time in seconds. Default 4.
